title: West PCB and V-B on the east cold-core roof

layout.comparison_y_placement: Rear fittings seated in the common 6mm panel, water inlet straight to ASSE, gas drop registered to the fixed core guide
layout.pcb_orientation: Flat, long dimension fore–aft; funnel/frame drops in after electrical connections
layout.relay_service: Roof removed; terminal tool approaches face +X
layout.water_header_poses: Rigid group7mm fore; original valve head rotations and all fitting axes retained
layout.planned_funnel_minus_y_expansion: Future funnel shape to be considered with the PCB below its current bowl
layout.psu_orientation: Flat on its back, AC aft and DC fore, screws upward
layout.psu_mount_service: Supply remains flat on the core; its independent fasteners and insulation detail remain to design
layout.connection_scope: Ten active JST plugs and their local wire bends, J10 power leads and selected PSU/relay local conductors; separate unplugging and screwdriver probes
layout.context_scope: Selected arrangement and explicit wall-mounted supports; not a production-pack migration
layout.wago_placement: Place junctions last, after primary components and wire routes, where connections are needed
layout.co2_flow: Bulkhead → 90° down → PISCO regulator → 180° up → Fluidfit check → 180° down → proposed core guide
layout.deferred_connections: Soda, vent and flavor ports show local departures; full onward routes are not placed
layout.pcb_lead_dressing: Local connector and wire envelopes checked quietly; harness drawings omitted
layout.co2_route_status: Layout candidate: proposed new cap guide remains unimplemented below the crown
layout.device_selection: PISCO regulator ordered (8638); separate check valve sourcing remains open
layout.ground_placement: Deferred until primary components and complete wire routes are placed
layout.relay_mount: Both PCB backs face the -X wall; components and screw heads face inward (+X)
layout.va_destination: Y-A port1, the flavor manifold shared-source tee; clean-water supply

va_route.turn_location: Flat beneath pump head; inlet west (-X), outlet fore (-Y)
va_route.insertion_scope: JG turn insertion is a family-based layout estimate; its scan does not establish an internal stop

layout.route_context: V-A, upstream group and Y-A/Y-B fixed; centered funnel outlet at Y179.19575; V-B on the core roof east of the PCB
layout.regulator_selection: YZMSZ · fixed 0.3 MPa / 43.5 psi · native push-connects · estimated 67 × Ø27 mm

metrics.tube_centerlines: Straight vertical core inlet and concealed axial outlet join

soda_route.flow: Proposed aft core soda guide → vertical tube → directly seated inlet stem → meter → concealed tube join → nested rear stems → soda bulkhead

upstream_handoff.source: Proposed soda guide in the current cold-core roof, aft of the pump inlet elbow
upstream_handoff.scope: The drawn tube extends 12 mm below the proposed handoff plane; the guide and internal core route require production integration

soda_route.scope: Measured exterior meter on edge with square component axes. Outlet collet faces meet with no exposed tube. The rear nested stem retains 2.4048 mm exposure for CO2 clearance. Socket engagement remains estimated; core-guide integration, pigtail and retention are separate.

funnel_gate.hardware_scope: V-A stays low; V-B feeds Y-B through an aft-side stair over the PCB. The valve inlet uses a directly seated stem elbow. The aft edge-on meter has no exposed outlet tube and a direct-down inlet to a proposed aft core guide.
funnel_gate.insertion_scope: Family-based layout estimates. Drain outlet stem retains 3.3058 mm exposure for the cradle; other stems seat shoulder-flush.

flow_meter.attachment: Proposed core-mounted support aft between the pump and CO2 path; retention detail is to design
flow_meter.scope: Direct-down inlet to proposed aft core guide and concealed outlet join shown; internal core integration, pigtail and retention remain separate

layout.pending_structure: Native V-B wall roots in the cold-core roof; production fusion and installed retention remain to qualify. PCB retention is to design.
layout.pcb_local_lead_dressing: J11 dresses aft with a 1 mm straight exit and R4 bend; other local estimates carry with the PCB

water.guide_scope: Down-facing outlet directly above an aft passive core guide; the internal continuation to the fixed carbonator port is production integration work.

gas_datums.check_geometry_scope: Vendor media scaled by sibling fixed-collar dimensions;16.891mm receiving depth is same-family inference, not an ACHV engineering dimension. Actual fit and flow orientation unmeasured.

purchased_checks.geometry_scope: Analytic exterior layout estimate derived from the exact product vendor GLB; no dimensioned ACHV44 engineering drawing or physical measurement

metrics.scope: Manual exterior fit query of the selected core-roof V-B/west-PCB arrangement, native V-B wall and local installed electrical connections; intended seated connections excluded
metrics.scope_limit: Native placement/fit query only. Complete harnesses, final equipment retention and production shell migration remain to design.

soda_outlet_route.tube_centerlines: Straight vertical core inlet and concealed axial outlet join

pcb_jst_service.scope: Nominal 6 mm axial JST withdrawal and 30 mm vertical columns above housing outlines, with roof removed. Does not model fingers or complete harness manipulation.
pcb_jst_service.service_order: Complete electrical connections before the funnel/frame drops in. Report both installed and removed states; plumbing may remain above the PCB.
